title: Workplaces - Les lieux de travail
summary: Kofi demande : 'Where does your mother work?' Comment répondre et parler des lieux de travail ?
lesson:
## Workplaces - Les lieux de travail

### Common Workplaces

- **Hospital** - hôpital (doctor, nurse)
- **School** - école (teacher)
- **Office** - bureau (secretary, manager)
- **Shop/Store** - magasin (shopkeeper, seller)
- **Farm** - ferme (farmer)
- **Restaurant** - restaurant (cook, waiter)
- **Factory** - usine (worker)
- **Bank** - banque (banker)
- **Garage** - garage (mechanic)
- **Police station** - commissariat (police officer)

## Asking About Workplaces

**Where do you work?**
**Where does he/she work?**

- I work **in** an office.
- She works **at** the hospital.
- He works **on** a farm.

## Prepositions

**IN** - dans (buildings)
- in a hospital, in a school, in an office

**AT** - à (specific places)
- at the bank, at the restaurant

**ON** - sur (farms)
- on a farm

## Job + Workplace

| Job | Workplace |
|-----|-----------|
| Doctor | Hospital |
| Teacher | School |
| Farmer | Farm |
| Cook | Restaurant |
| Mechanic | Garage |

exercise.question: Associe le métier et le lieu : 1) A doctor works ___. 2) A teacher works ___. 3) A farmer works ___.
exercise.answer:
**Solution :**
1) A doctor works **in a hospital**.
2) A teacher works **in a school**.
3) A farmer works **on a farm**.
